botswana/adventure.caption: Mokoro, Walking, Horseback
botswana/adventure.description: Poled canoes, walking safaris on the islands, and some of the best riding safaris anywhere.
botswana/adventure.alt: riders crossing a floodplain on a horseback safari, Botswana

botswana/architecture.caption: Tent, Deck and Sand
botswana/architecture.description: Camps built on decks above the flood, taken down when the concession lease ends.
botswana/architecture.alt: a tented camp on a deck above the Okavango floodplain, Botswana

botswana/beaches.caption: Landlocked
botswana/beaches.description: The nearest sea is a thousand kilometres away, and nobody here seems to mind.
botswana/beaches.alt: a floodplain island in the Okavango at sunrise, Botswana

botswana/cities.caption: Maun and Kasane
botswana/cities.description: Not really cities — two safari towns with airstrips, which is what the country needs.
botswana/cities.alt: light aircraft on the apron at Maun airport, Botswana

botswana/crafts.caption: Basketry
botswana/crafts.description: Palm baskets woven in the delta panhandle, dyed with bark, and collected worldwide.
botswana/crafts.alt: woven palm baskets from the Okavango panhandle, Botswana

botswana/culture.caption: Batswana and San
botswana/culture.description: Setswana across the country, and San communities in the Kalahari with the oldest culture on earth.
botswana/culture.alt: a San tracker reading spoor in the Kalahari sand, Botswana

botswana/eco-tourism.caption: Community Trusts
botswana/eco-tourism.description: Concessions leased through community trusts, so the villages hold the lease and the income.
botswana/eco-tourism.alt: a community conservation sign at a delta concession, Botswana

botswana/family-community.caption: Not the Cheapest, but Quiet
botswana/family-community.description: Not a budget destination — but the children will not be sharing a sighting with ten vehicles.
botswana/family-community.alt: a family on a mokoro in the Okavango channels, Botswana

botswana/festivals.caption: Maitisong and Dithubaruba
botswana/festivals.description: The Maitisong festival in Gaborone, and the Kweneng cultural festival at Dithubaruba.
botswana/festivals.alt: dancers performing at a cultural festival in Botswana

botswana/food.caption: Seswaa and Bogobe
botswana/food.description: Slow-pounded beef and sorghum porridge, and braai wherever there is a fire.
botswana/food.alt: seswaa and bogobe served at a Botswana lodge

botswana/forests.caption: Riverine and Mopane
botswana/forests.description: Riverine forest along the Chobe, and mopane woodland across the north.
botswana/forests.alt: riverine forest along the Chobe river bank, Botswana

botswana/heritage.caption: Diamonds and Democracy
botswana/heritage.description: Independent since 1966, and the one African country that used its diamonds well.
botswana/heritage.alt: the National Museum building in Gaborone, Botswana

botswana/hero.caption: A Delta That Never Reaches the Sea
botswana/hero.description: The Okavango floods into the Kalahari every year and simply disappears into it.
botswana/hero.alt: the channels and islands of the Okavango delta from the air, Botswana

botswana/hidden-gems.caption: The Makgadikgadi
botswana/hidden-gems.description: Drive onto the pan at night and there is no horizon and no sound at all.
botswana/hidden-gems.alt: quad bikes on the Makgadikgadi salt pan at dusk, Botswana

botswana/historic-sites.caption: Tsodilo Hills
botswana/historic-sites.description: Four thousand paintings on four hills the San call the resting place of the gods.
botswana/historic-sites.alt: rock paintings on the Tsodilo hills, Botswana

botswana/lakes-rivers.caption: The Okavango and the Chobe
botswana/lakes-rivers.description: A mokoro poled through papyrus channels is the correct speed for this country.
botswana/lakes-rivers.alt: a mokoro being poled through a papyrus channel, Botswana

botswana/local-life.caption: Cattle Posts
botswana/local-life.description: Away from the parks the country is cattle, and the cattle post is the centre of it.
botswana/local-life.alt: a cattle post at the edge of the Kalahari, Botswana

botswana/luxury.caption: The Concession Camps
botswana/luxury.description: Private concessions the size of small countries, with six tents on them.
botswana/luxury.alt: a small luxury tented camp lit at dusk in the delta, Botswana

botswana/mountains.caption: Tsodilo
botswana/mountains.description: No real mountains — Tsodilo's four hills hold four thousand rock paintings instead.
botswana/mountains.alt: the Tsodilo hills rising from flat Kalahari scrub, Botswana

botswana/nature.caption: Delta, Pan and Desert
botswana/nature.description: Water in the north, salt pans in the middle, and Kalahari sand for the rest of it.
botswana/nature.alt: the Makgadikgadi salt pans stretching to the horizon, Botswana

botswana/outdoor.caption: Mokoro and Walking
botswana/outdoor.description: Poling, walking and riding — this is the country where you get out of the vehicle.
botswana/outdoor.alt: walkers following a guide across an Okavango island, Botswana

botswana/photography.caption: Water and Light
botswana/photography.description: Aerial work over the delta, and reflections that only exist for the weeks of the flood.
botswana/photography.alt: aerial view of flooded Okavango channels at golden hour, Botswana

botswana/safari.caption: Low Volume, High Value
botswana/safari.description: Fewer beds, larger concessions, and game drives that do not meet another vehicle.
botswana/safari.alt: a game vehicle alone on a track in the Okavango, Botswana

botswana/traditional-people.caption: The Kalahari San
botswana/traditional-people.description: Tracking with San guides, who will find in an hour what nobody else sees at all.
botswana/traditional-people.alt: San guides walking a Kalahari pan in the morning, Botswana

botswana/waterfalls.caption: No Falls, and the Zambezi Next Door
botswana/waterfalls.description: The water here spreads rather than drops; Victoria Falls is ninety minutes from Kasane.
botswana/waterfalls.alt: the Chobe river spreading wide at sunset, Botswana

botswana/why-visit.caption: Fewer People Than Elephants
botswana/why-visit.description: Two and a half million people, a hundred and thirty thousand elephant, and space for both.
botswana/why-visit.alt: an elephant herd crossing open Kalahari grassland, Botswana

botswana/wildlife.caption: The Largest Elephant Population
botswana/wildlife.description: Chobe holds more elephant than anywhere on earth, and they come to the river at four.
botswana/wildlife.alt: elephants coming down to the Chobe river in late light, Botswana

cameroon/adventure.caption: Summit, Crater, Coast
cameroon/adventure.description: The Guinness route to 4,095 m, down the north flank to Mann's Spring, and out to the sea on the same trip.
cameroon/adventure.alt: walkers crossing grass slopes below the summit huts on Mount Cameroon

cameroon/architecture.caption: Chefferie and Colonial Buea
cameroon/architecture.description: Bamileke chefferie compounds with carved posts and conical roofs, and the German Schloss on the hill above Buea.
cameroon/architecture.alt: a Bamileke chieftaincy compound with carved posts and a conical thatched roof, Cameroon

cameroon/beaches.caption: Black Sand and Warm Water
cameroon/beaches.description: Volcanic grey-black sand at Limbe, white sand and fishing pirogues at Kribi, warm all year on both.
cameroon/beaches.alt: surf breaking on volcanic black sand at dusk on the Cameroon coast near Limbe

cameroon/cities.caption: Douala and Yaounde
cameroon/cities.description: The port that moves the country and the hill capital that governs it, ninety minutes apart by air and nothing alike.
cameroon/cities.alt: a street in the Bonapriso quarter of Douala, Cameroon

cameroon/crafts.caption: The Foumban Bronze Casters
cameroon/crafts.description: Lost-wax bronze, beaded thrones and carved masks made on the craft street the same way they were three centuries ago.
cameroon/crafts.alt: a bronze caster working molten metal in a workshop at Foumban, Cameroon

cameroon/culture.caption: The Grassfields Kingdoms
cameroon/culture.description: Bamileke and Bamoun chiefdoms in the west, still functioning, with palaces, secret societies and their own calendars.
cameroon/culture.alt: a carved and beaded royal throne inside a palace museum at Foumban, Cameroon

cameroon/eco-tourism.query: Cameroon forest guide identifying tree species inside ecotourism conservation
cameroon/eco-tourism.alt: a forest guide identifying a tree species inside Korup rainforest, Cameroon

cameroon/family-community.caption: Village and Mountain Together
cameroon/family-community.description: Guides and porters come from the mountain villages in rotation, and the trail money goes back into the village fund.
cameroon/family-community.alt: villagers and guides repairing a stone section of mountain trail together, Cameroon

cameroon/festivals.query: Cameroon masked dancers horsemen nguon festival foumban celebration dance
cameroon/festivals.alt: masked dancers and horsemen at the Nguon festival in Foumban, Cameroon

cameroon/food.caption: Ndole, Poulet DG and Grilled Fish
cameroon/food.description: Bitterleaf and groundnut ndolé, plantain, and whole fish grilled on the sand at Kribi within sight of the boat.
cameroon/food.alt: grilled fish and plantain served at a beachside stall in Kribi, Cameroon

cameroon/forests.caption: Inside Korup
cameroon/forests.description: One of the oldest rainforests in Africa, with a canopy suspension bridge over the Mana river and 400 tree species.
cameroon/forests.alt: a canopy suspension bridge over a river inside Korup rainforest, Cameroon

cameroon/heritage.caption: Dja, Rhumsiki and the Mandara
cameroon/heritage.description: The Dja Faunal Reserve is UNESCO World Heritage; the volcanic spires above Rhumsiki are the image on the old banknote.
cameroon/heritage.alt: volcanic rock spires rising from farmland at Rhumsiki in the Mandara mountains, Cameroon

cameroon/hero.query: Cameroon upper slopes mount cameroon above atlantic landscape iconic
cameroon/hero.alt: the upper slopes of Mount Cameroon at dawn above the Atlantic

cameroon/hidden-gems.caption: The 1999 Lava Fields
cameroon/hidden-gems.description: Black lava tongues from the 1999 and 2000 flows running down to the sea near Bakingili, with green already coming back.
cameroon/hidden-gems.alt: black solidified lava flows reaching the sea on the flank of Mount Cameroon

cameroon/historic-sites.caption: The Sultan's Palace
cameroon/historic-sites.description: The 1917 palace at Foumban and its museum of the Bamoun kings, plus the German colonial buildings still standing in Buea.
cameroon/historic-sites.alt: the Sultan's Palace at Foumban with its museum of the Bamoun kings, Cameroon

cameroon/lakes-rivers.query: Cameroon brown benoue river gallery forest along lake water
cameroon/lakes-rivers.alt: the wide brown Benoue river with gallery forest along the bank, Cameroon

cameroon/local-life.caption: Marche Central, Motos, Rain
cameroon/local-life.description: Bilingual, loud and unbothered: Douala's markets, the moto-taxis, and the sudden rain everyone waits out under an awning.
cameroon/local-life.alt: traders and moto-taxis in a busy Douala market street, Cameroon

cameroon/luxury.caption: Kribi, Slowly
cameroon/luxury.description: Small beach hotels south of Kribi, a driver who knows the road, and nothing at all scheduled after lunch.
cameroon/luxury.alt: a small beach hotel terrace above the sand at Kribi, Cameroon

cameroon/mountains.alt: trekkers on the open upper slopes of Mount Cameroon above the tree line

cameroon/outdoor.caption: The Ring Road on Foot
cameroon/outdoor.description: Crater lakes, tea slopes and the Ring Road through the Bamenda highlands, walkable in sections between 1,200 and 2,000 m.
cameroon/outdoor.alt: open dry-season slopes and ridge lines on Mount Cameroon

cameroon/photography.caption: Cloud on the Rainforest
cameroon/photography.description: Wet season cloud sitting on the forest above Buea, and dry season light on the Mandara spires — two countries, one lens.
cameroon/photography.alt: cloud and rain sitting on the rainforest above Buea, Cameroon

cameroon/safari.query: Cameroon elephants giraffe dry season waterhole waza safari game drive
cameroon/safari.alt: elephants and giraffe at a dry-season waterhole in Waza National Park, Cameroon

cameroon/traditional-people.caption: Fulani, Mafa and Bamileke
cameroon/traditional-people.description: Two hundred and fifty ethnic groups and as many languages, from the Mafa terraces of the Mandara to the Fulani of the Sahel.
cameroon/traditional-people.alt: a Mafa farmer on the terraced slopes of the Mandara mountains, Cameroon

cameroon/waterfalls.caption: Where the River Meets the Sea
cameroon/waterfalls.description: The Lobé falls near Kribi drop straight over black rock into the Atlantic — one of very few waterfalls on earth that do.
cameroon/waterfalls.alt: the Lobe waterfalls pouring over rock directly into the Atlantic near Kribi, Cameroon

cameroon/why-visit.caption: Everything, Within One Border
cameroon/why-visit.description: Sea level to Sahel in nine hundred kilometres, French and English on the same road, and almost nobody else on it.
cameroon/why-visit.alt: a 4x4 on a red laterite road between rainforest and highland farmland, Cameroon

cameroon/wildlife.alt: forest elephants among buttressed trees in Korup National Park, Cameroon

cote-divoire/adventure.caption: Surf, Hike, Paddle
cote-divoire/adventure.description: Surf at Assinie, hiking the western hills, and pirogues through the lagoon.
cote-divoire/adventure.alt: surfers in the water off Assinie, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/architecture.caption: Lagoon Colonial
cote-divoire/architecture.description: The wooden trading houses of Grand-Bassam, and Abidjan's tropical modernism.
cote-divoire/architecture.alt: a colonial trading house on the Grand-Bassam waterfront, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/beaches.caption: Assinie and Grand-Béréby
cote-divoire/beaches.description: Assinie's sandbar east of Abidjan, and the quieter Atlantic beaches to the west.
cote-divoire/beaches.alt: palms and surf on the beach at Assinie, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/cities.caption: Abidjan
cote-divoire/cities.description: The Plateau's towers, the Ébrié lagoon, and a nightlife the region measures itself against.
cote-divoire/cities.alt: the towers of the Plateau district in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/crafts.caption: Weaving and Carving
cote-divoire/crafts.description: Baoulé strip cloth, Korhogo painted cloth, and Dan masks carved for use rather than sale.
cote-divoire/crafts.alt: Korhogo cloth painted with mud pigment, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/culture.caption: Sixty Peoples
cote-divoire/culture.description: Akan, Krou, Mandé and Gur — around sixty peoples inside one border.
cote-divoire/culture.alt: a Baoulé mask dance in central Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/eco-tourism.caption: Taï and the Chimpanzees
cote-divoire/eco-tourism.description: Forty years of chimpanzee research at Taï, run with the villages around the park.
cote-divoire/eco-tourism.alt: a researcher on a forest trail at Taï, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/family-community.caption: Beach and Lagoon
cote-divoire/family-community.description: Assinie's sandbar has ocean on one side and calm lagoon on the other, which suits children.
cote-divoire/family-community.alt: children swimming on the lagoon side at Assinie, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/festivals.caption: Abissa and the Masks
cote-divoire/festivals.description: Abissa at Grand-Bassam in November, and the mask festivals of the western hills.
cote-divoire/festivals.alt: masked dancers at the Abissa festival in Grand-Bassam, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/food.caption: Attiéké and Kedjenou
cote-divoire/food.description: Attiéké with grilled fish, and kedjenou slow-cooked in a sealed pot.
cote-divoire/food.alt: attiéké and grilled fish served at a maquis, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/forests.caption: Taï Rainforest
cote-divoire/forests.description: One of the last blocks of primary rainforest in West Africa, and chimpanzees that use tools.
cote-divoire/forests.alt: primary rainforest interior at Taï, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/heritage.caption: Yamoussoukro
cote-divoire/heritage.description: A basilica larger than Saint Peter's, built in the founder's home village.
cote-divoire/heritage.alt: the basilica of Our Lady of Peace at Yamoussoukro, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/hero.caption: Lagoons, Forest and the Atlantic
cote-divoire/hero.description: A lagoon city, one of West Africa's last rainforests, and five hundred kilometres of Atlantic.
cote-divoire/hero.alt: the Abidjan skyline across the Ébrié lagoon, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/hidden-gems.caption: Man
cote-divoire/hidden-gems.description: The western hills, with waterfalls, mask villages and a mountain nobody climbs.
cote-divoire/hidden-gems.alt: the hills and forest around the town of Man, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/historic-sites.caption: Grand-Bassam
cote-divoire/historic-sites.description: The first colonial capital, on a sandbar between lagoon and ocean, and now a world site.
cote-divoire/historic-sites.alt: the colonial quarter of Grand-Bassam, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/lakes-rivers.caption: The Ébrié and the Bandama
cote-divoire/lakes-rivers.description: The lagoon system behind the coast, and the Bandama running the length of the country.
cote-divoire/lakes-rivers.alt: pirogues on the Ébrié lagoon at dusk, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/local-life.caption: Maquis at Night
cote-divoire/local-life.description: The open-air maquis — grill, music and a plastic chair — is the country's real institution.
cote-divoire/local-life.alt: a busy open-air maquis at night in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/luxury.caption: Assinie and Abidjan
cote-divoire/luxury.description: Lagoon villas at Assinie, and Abidjan hotels that serve the whole region's business.
cote-divoire/luxury.alt: a lagoon-side villa terrace at Assinie, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/mountains.caption: Mount Nimba
cote-divoire/mountains.description: The Nimba range on the Guinea and Liberia border, at 1,752 metres, with its own species.
cote-divoire/mountains.alt: the grassy summit ridge of Mount Nimba, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/nature.caption: Forest to Savanna
cote-divoire/nature.description: Rainforest in the south-west, a lagoon coast, and savanna running north to Mali.
cote-divoire/nature.alt: the Ébrié lagoon fringed with palms, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/outdoor.caption: Surf and Hike
cote-divoire/outdoor.description: Assinie's breaks, and the liana bridges and falls in the hills around Man.
cote-divoire/outdoor.alt: a liana bridge strung across a river near Man, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/photography.caption: Lagoon Light
cote-divoire/photography.description: Pirogues on flat water at either end of the day, and a skyline behind them.
cote-divoire/photography.alt: pirogues silhouetted on the lagoon at sunset, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/safari.caption: Comoé
cote-divoire/safari.description: One of the largest protected areas in West Africa, with elephant, buffalo and hippo.
cote-divoire/safari.alt: open savanna and gallery forest at Comoé, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/traditional-people.caption: Baoulé, Senufo and Dan
cote-divoire/traditional-people.description: Baoulé weaving, Senufo sculpture, and Dan masks from the western hills.
cote-divoire/traditional-people.alt: Senufo carved figures on a workshop bench, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/waterfalls.caption: Man and the Waterfalls
cote-divoire/waterfalls.description: The falls around Man in the western hills, and the liana bridges strung above them.
cote-divoire/waterfalls.alt: a waterfall in the hills around Man, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/why-visit.caption: The Engine of the Region
cote-divoire/why-visit.description: The largest economy in francophone West Africa, and the easiest of them to travel.
cote-divoire/why-visit.alt: a coastal highway running west out of Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire

cote-divoire/wildlife.caption: Taï and Comoé
cote-divoire/wildlife.description: Pygmy hippo and chimpanzees at Taï, and Comoé's savanna in the north-east.
cote-divoire/wildlife.alt: dense rainforest canopy at Taï national park, Côte d'Ivoire

egypt/adventure.caption: Desert Crossings
egypt/adventure.description: Diving the Red Sea, walking the Sinai with Bedouin guides, and crossing the sand sea by vehicle.
egypt/adventure.alt: a vehicle crossing dunes in the Great Sand Sea, Egypt

egypt/architecture.caption: Mamluk Cairo
egypt/architecture.description: The mosques, sabils and madrasas of the medieval city, largely still standing.
egypt/architecture.alt: the carved stone facade of a Mamluk mosque in Cairo, Egypt

egypt/beaches.caption: The Red Sea
egypt/beaches.description: Some of the clearest reef diving on earth, an hour's flight from the pyramids.
egypt/beaches.alt: coral reef and clear water on the Red Sea coast, Egypt

egypt/cities.caption: Cairo and Alexandria
egypt/cities.description: Twenty million people on the Nile, and a Mediterranean city that remembers being Greek.
egypt/cities.alt: the Alexandria corniche curving along the Mediterranean, Egypt

egypt/crafts.caption: Papyrus, Glass and Cotton
egypt/crafts.description: Hand-blown glass in Cairo, Egyptian cotton, and papyrus made the way it always was.
egypt/crafts.alt: a glassblower working in a Cairo workshop, Egypt

egypt/culture.caption: Coptic, Islamic, Pharaonic
egypt/culture.description: Three layers still in daily use, sometimes in the same street in old Cairo.
egypt/culture.alt: the minarets and rooftops of Islamic Cairo, Egypt

egypt/eco-tourism.caption: Reef and Oasis
egypt/eco-tourism.description: Reef protection on the Red Sea, and oasis agriculture that has managed water for millennia.
egypt/eco-tourism.alt: a marine reserve buoy over Red Sea reef, Egypt

egypt/family-community.caption: Straightforward with Children
egypt/family-community.description: Short internal flights, boats instead of buses, and a story at every stop.
egypt/family-community.alt: a family boarding a Nile cruise boat at Luxor, Egypt

egypt/festivals.caption: Moulids and Ramadan
egypt/festivals.description: The moulid processions, and Cairo at iftar when the whole city eats at once.
egypt/festivals.alt: lanterns strung across a Cairo street for Ramadan, Egypt

egypt/food.caption: Ful, Koshary and Bread
egypt/food.description: Breakfast is ful and bread; lunch is koshary; both are older than most cuisines.
egypt/food.alt: koshary being served at a Cairo street kitchen, Egypt

egypt/forests.caption: The Fayoum
egypt/forests.description: Not forest — the Fayoum's palm and olive, and the acacia of Wadi el-Rayan.
egypt/forests.alt: palm groves in the Fayoum oasis, Egypt

egypt/heritage.caption: Karnak, Luxor, Abu Simbel
egypt/heritage.description: Karnak took two thousand years to build; Abu Simbel was moved sixty metres to save it.
egypt/heritage.alt: the hypostyle hall columns at Karnak, Egypt

egypt/hero.caption: Five Thousand Years
egypt/hero.description: The Nile made the country and the country has been recording it ever since.
egypt/hero.alt: the Giza pyramids at first light across the desert, Egypt

egypt/hidden-gems.caption: Siwa
egypt/hidden-gems.description: Eight hundred kilometres west, a Berber-speaking oasis with its own language and salt lakes.
egypt/hidden-gems.alt: salt pools and palms at the Siwa oasis, Egypt

egypt/historic-sites.caption: The Valley of the Kings
egypt/historic-sites.description: Sixty-odd tombs cut into a single dry valley, most of them painted floor to ceiling.
egypt/historic-sites.alt: painted tomb walls in the Valley of the Kings, Egypt

egypt/lakes-rivers.caption: The Nile Itself
egypt/lakes-rivers.description: Feluccas under sail at Aswan, and a river that has been the country's main road for millennia.
egypt/lakes-rivers.alt: a felucca under sail on the Nile at Aswan, Egypt

egypt/local-life.caption: The Corniche at Dusk
egypt/local-life.description: Families out along the river, tea on the pavement, and the traffic finally slowing.
egypt/local-life.alt: families walking the Nile corniche in Cairo at dusk, Egypt

egypt/luxury.caption: Dahabiyas and Desert Camps
egypt/luxury.description: Small sailing dahabiyas instead of the big cruisers, and camps in the White Desert.
egypt/luxury.alt: a dahabiya sailing boat moored on the Nile at sunset, Egypt
